body: Crisp 16-bit pixel-art reaction icon, locked front camera. A cheerful golden retriever wearing dark pixel sunglasses gives a double thumbs-up while small yellow pixel stars pop around its head and disappear. Return to the star-free starting pose on the final frame. Deep midnight-blue background, limited palette, no text.
